title: A Cellar for the Harvest
author: A. M. Eriksen
blurb: Yara Voss, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
